about.title: About
about.what: Porodex is a free field guide for League of Legends and Teamfight Tactics: champions, items, traits, a team builder and quizzes.
about.data: Data comes from Data Dragon (LoL) and Community Dragon (TFT), downloaded and built into static pages whenever a new patch ships. TFT ability numbers depend on star level, so some values show a ? instead.
